Kill [[Justiciar Sevaan]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Take the [[Secret River Passage]] to [[Divinity Coast (explorable area)|Divinity Coast]] and kill [[Justiciar Sevaan]]. 
* *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Sevaan in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 7 War Supplies

== Walkthrough ==
Make your way (preferably from [[Temple of the Ages]]) to the Secret River Passage located in the north of [[Talmark Wilderness]].

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''The good folk of Divinity Coast have been preyed upon by Peacekeeper bandits and White Mantle thugs, but none has proved as oppressive and offensive as Justiciar Sevaan. A severe, cruel man who abuses the weak and elderly for sport, Sevaan must be stopped. The friend of Kryta who slays Justiciar Sevaan will earn a royal bounty and likely a celebatory round of ale from a grateful populace. Take the Secret River Passage in Talmark Wilderness to sneak into Divinity Coast without being noticed by the White Mantle in Shaemoor.''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive this classic event from the War in Kryta! During the war, the good folk of Divinity Coast were preyed upon by many Peacekeeper bandits and White Mantle thugs, but none was as oppressive and offensive as Justiciar Sevaan. A severe, cruel man who abused the weak and elderly for sport, Sevaan was permanently stopped by foreign allies of Kryta. Re-create the hunt for Justiciar Sevaan in this completely accurate historical scenario. Eliminate the villain again and you will earn your bounty!"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Put an end to Justiciar Sevaan's cruelty. Go to Divinity Coast and eliminate the infamous thug. You will need to take the Secret River Passage in Talmark Wilderness to arrive without suspicion.
}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you [Character Name], your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

== Notes ==
* To reach the Divinity Coast, exit from the Temple of the Ages into [[The Black Curtain]] and head to Talmark Wilderness. The Secret River Passage is on a patch of sand, next to [[Ember Whisperwind]].
* Combines well with [[A Little Help From Above]], which also requires you to kill Justicar Sevaan.
